data.content_ref: inline:The problem asks 'which of the two properties [idempotent or safe] must an append-only event log actually require of its writers.' SRC_001 answers 'neither' and substitutes commutativity of the consumer's fold—a property that is (a) not one of the two options the question asks to choose between and (b) a consumer/read-side property, not a writer-side property, while the question explicitly scopes the requirement to 'its writers.' Additionally, SRC_001 conflates two mathematically distinct concepts: commutativity (order-independence: f(a,b)=f(b,a)) and idempotency (repetition-independence: f(f(x))=f(x)), calling them 'commutativity (or more precisely, idempotent with respect to duplicate events).' These are not the same property; an operation can be commutative without being idempotent and vice versa. This conflation undermines the core reframe the target proposes.
